question: What different outcomes arise under the lunar mansions Kṛttikā and Rohiṇī?
premises: Kṛttikā is associated with becoming unhappy
Rohiṇī is specified as another mansion
One becomes lord of speech in Rohiṇī
inference: Kṛttikā brings unhappiness while Rohiṇī brings mastery of speech
plain_english: In Kṛttikā one becomes unhappy, and in Rohiṇī one becomes a lord of speech.
